title: Three Nights and One Short Thermometer
subtitle: 健康医疗 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 健康医疗（人与自我·生活与学习·健康的生活方式、个人安全与自救）
meta: 主题语境：健康医疗（人与自我·生活与学习·健康的生活方式、个人安全与自救）　|　核心词汇：operation　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 operation 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1971 the nurse ① performed the operation that no sufferer in the ward would have described, and he said the performing was the whole of the night. The ② operation, meaning the procedure itself and not the thermometer, ran three nights and stayed undescribed in the book; an operation, he said, is the only thing in a ward that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ operation in that ward had the same short thermometer beside it, and the ④ operation at the far cupboard, meaning the dose they kept for the children to take and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. An operation, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the nurse said the describing is the part that fills three nights.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the operation was the whole of the matter, meaning the risk and not the procedure. The ⑥ operation, meaning the risk and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; operation, he said, is either something you perform or the only word that means both a procedure and a risk. He said the risk is the part they remember.

By 1976 the ⑦ operation had become a line in a report, and the report had become an argument about the short thermometer. The ⑧ operation of the whole thing, the nurse wrote in April, was one ward and three nights of describing; operation, he said, is either the dose at the far cupboard or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ operation I remember is the procedure described in the report, which closed in 1978 and is still described as the quietest in the ward. An ⑩ operation, my mother said in 1980, is the only procedure that improves by being described; every operation, she said, is a risk that has agreed to look like a procedure. She said the risk was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 手术；操作（指病房里每一台旁边的那一台）
B. n. 手术；操作（指那台手术本身，与细细的体温计相对）
C. 固定搭配：perform the operation 施行这一台手术
D. n. 手术；操作（指留给孩子们服的那一剂）
E. n. 手术之事（抽象总称，指一处病房的手术之事）
F. n. 手术；操作（指护理记录里写到、被描述的那一台）
G. n. 手术、风险（指一件事里人人都熬却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 风险（抽象总称，指人人都熬却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: performed the operation that no sufferer in the ward would have described
The operation, meaning the procedure itself and not the thermometer
the operation at the far cupboard
the operation was the whole of the matter
the operation had become a line in a report
The operation of the whole thing
An operation, my mother said in 1980

answers.why: perform the operation 意为“施行这一台手术”，1971 年那位护士把病房里没有一位病患肯描述的一台手术做了一遍。
operation 意为“手术；操作”，指那台手术本身而不是细细的体温计，它经过了三个夜晚而在簿子上没有被描述。
operation 意为“手术；操作”，指病房里每一台旁边的那一台，每一台旁边都有同一支细细的体温计。
operation 意为“手术；操作”，指最远那格药柜的留给孩子们服的那一剂，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
operation 意为“手术、风险”，指一件事里人人都熬却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这台风险就是那件事的全部。
operation 意为“风险”，指人人都熬却无人提起的那样东西而不是那台手术，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
operation 意为“手术；操作”，指护理记录里写到、被描述的那一台，到 1976 年这一台成了护理记录里的一行。
operation 意为“手术之事”，护士四月写道，整件事的手术之事是一处病房和三个夜晚的描述。
operation 意为“手术；操作”，我记得的是护理记录里描述过的那一台，1978 年挺过了，至今仍被说成病房里最安静的一台。
operation 为抽象总称，母亲 1980 年说，手术是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的手术。
